confirmed_engineering_findings.title: U5 has no guaranteed reset after a slow rail rise
confirmed_engineering_findings.observed: Fresh netlist and schematic show RES connected only to a 10k pullup and TP3. No reset controller or commanded reset connection exists.
confirmed_engineering_findings.requirement: Honeywell requires VDD rise at least10V/ms or use RES after power stabilizes. TPS563203 typical soft-start1.4ms implies approximately2.36V/ms average for3.3V; this is a datasheet-based expectation, not a measured waveform.
confirmed_engineering_findings.impact: Reliable cold start and brownout recovery are not established; not proof every prototype fails. Firmware waiting alone does not generate RES.
confirmed_engineering_findings.action: Implement and qualify a valid sensor reset strategy, or supply measured/vendored evidence meeting the required startup conditions. No fix performed in this read-only review.

confirmed_engineering_findings.title: Nominal6V valve rail has no margin below valve operating maximum
confirmed_engineering_findings.observed: Fresh netlist:270k±1%/30k±1% divider. FA0520E manufacturer specification operating5–6V.

calculation.assumptions: 0.600V reference±2%, divider resistor±1%, before ripple/transients; ignores resistor thermal drift and FB bias effects.

confirmed_engineering_findings.impact: Upper tolerances can exceed the published operating range. This establishes absent guaranteed margin, not immediate destructive failure.
confirmed_engineering_findings.action: Lower target with full corner/transient verification, or obtain explicit vendor qualification for actual applied range.
confirmed_engineering_findings.duty_note: 10s on/10s off endurance and8h6V abnormal no-burning/no-smoking tests do not establish continuous functional life.

bench_and_system_risks.title: U12/input current and thermal qualification
bench_and_system_risks.evidence: VIN output includes0.3mm-wide2mm-long approach; VIN_RAW has0.3mm-wide0.8mm power approach and1.1mm capacitor branch. Input bypass C66 is3.125mm pad distance; output C67 is4.834mm.
bench_and_system_risks.status: No thermal failure established from geometry. Validate load/startup current, fuse/eFuse behavior, short circuit and sustained-temperature performance on actual copper stack and adapter. Widening short power necks is a reasonable refinement if revising.

bench_and_system_risks.title: Buck stability, startup and inductive load switching
bench_and_system_risks.evidence: Fresh circuit assertions confirm each4.7uH,18pF feed-forward and local capacitors. Pump/valve nominal output total88.3uF each. Inputs nearest10uF pads2.32–2.35mm; output/FB remain local. SW traces use short back-layer runs and vias.
bench_and_system_risks.status: Effective capacitor bias/temperature/ESR, inductor current, simultaneous motor starting, stall, PWM ripple, ground noise, flyback and thermal margin require measurements. No claim of failure or validated stability from nominal values.

bench_and_system_risks.title: Actual Qwiic expansion budget is unspecified
bench_and_system_risks.evidence: Local3V3 has64.51uF nominal onboard bypass/bulk. Additional sensor-module capacitance, pullups, current, addresses and cable lengths were not specified.
bench_and_system_risks.status: Cannot certify arbitrary module combinations. Review aggregate current, effective Cout, bus capacitance/rise time and pullup sink current. Master confirmed WRL-15663.

bench_and_system_risks.title: Qwiic power-state and multi-board qualification
bench_and_system_risks.evidence: Fresh J9 and U13 pin assertions confirm separate host/local rails, local A/host B,EN tiedHOST3V3, common GND.
bench_and_system_risks.status: Qualify host/board independently on/off, brownouts, hot-plug/leakage. For TCA9548A enable exactly one channel, selected branch effective pullup≥2.2k including all parallel resistors/tolerances, total selected host current≤3mA. No upstream B-side buffer/rise accelerator.

bench_and_system_risks.title: External connector ESD/environment
bench_and_system_risks.evidence: No dedicated SDA/SCL TVS or port current limiting identified in fresh netlist. D36 protects input power domain, not external data pins.
bench_and_system_risks.status: Conditional field/handling qualification risk, not a proven basic-function fault. Decide required ESD/hot-plug robustness from operating environment.

bench_and_system_risks.title: Physical assembly and mechanics
bench_and_system_risks.evidence: Native closed outline109×126.4mm; four3.5mm plated corner mounting holes, two3.5mm nonplated valve-area holes, four4mm pump terminal holes; connector/access markings shown.
bench_and_system_risks.status: Actual pumps/nozzles, cables, valve attachment, standoffs, solder joints, restraint and enclosure/hose clearance remain physical checks. 2D CAD does not validate physical fit.

bench_and_system_risks.title: Firmware and loss-of-master behavior
bench_and_system_risks.evidence: Fresh topology retains output state without watchdog; buttons go to GPIO inputs, not direct load-interlock. Documented channel map matches observed nets.
bench_and_system_risks.status: User explicitly selected keep-last-command and intermittent fixed-direction pumps. Firmware must preserve safe cold initialization, correct register/channel mapping and multi-board mux discipline; no firmware execution performed.

heuristic_adjudication.result: Not an IC-supply decoupling defect: fresh netlist shows+12V only between jack and fuse. Protected VIN_RAW hasC65/C66, VIN hasC67 and three10uF pairs. Do not treat aggregate NOT READY string as stronger evidence than this topology.
optional_suggestions: Dedicated testpoints on+12V,+3V3,+4V5,+6V,VIN would aid production probes; currently rail access through component/connector pads.
No dedicated board fiducial footprint appears in166-part inventory; assembler panel/tooling fiducials require process acceptance.

visual_review.method: Fresh native schematic and front/back copper, silkscreen, assembly and mask/paste PDFs, rendered6500px wide; six board regions and six schematic regions inspected. No editor document switch.
visual_review.result: No additional gross layout, routing, polarity-mark or solder-opening defect found beyond engineering items above. All signal/power connectivity reconciled. Bulk polarity marks, diode body/cathode markings, pin1 marks, master-versus-sensor power labels and revision marking are present in reviewed drawings.
layout_notes: Bypass pads are within approximately4.3mm of local logic supply pads; this is straight-pad distance, not loop inductance.
All three feedback networks are compact local front-layer routes; power-ground pours and stitching are present. No automatic EMI or thermal certification inferred.
Mask drawings do not expose switch-node track runs beyond intended component-pad openings.
Board-reference text is not uniformly present in the simple silk export; use the supplied assembly drawing for dense reference identification. This is not a connectivity failure.
visual_review.limits: 2D visual inspection cannot prove solderability,3D interference, EMI, thermal performance, assembly orientation after manufacturer processing, or delivered board quality.
